limitations: A manifest download is not a complete layer/blob download or image execution.
Config/layer descriptors are recorded, not fetched; single-manifest platform is not independently read.
Transport/auth/rate-limit errors leave availability unknown; no missing image is removed.
Two readers stop new requests after 401, 429 or three consecutive transport failures. No retries or tag substitutions.
Temporary anonymous registry token is not an LLM key and is never saved.
